item: law ingest report: the last-status mix replaces the awaiting_re_extraction counter (F10)
summary: The diagnostics bundle of 2026-11-07 said all 23 law documents were awaiting re-extraction. That was the counter's own artifact: the tracker writes 're-read with ...' on the one poll that re-baselines a document through the strip stage and 'unchanged' on the next, so counting checked documents whose last status is not a re-read read N of N on a fully healed install. The report now gives last_status_mix (the Law tab's own verdicts via src.api.law._verdict_of) and, per document, the verdict and last_checked_at (UTC), which say which documents are failing now and when each was last attempted. They mark candidates for still holding pre-strip text, never proof: a re-read leaves no lasting trace, so a document that healed and fails today reads the same as one that never healed. Diagnostics only: no UI string, no schema, no fetch.
